name: Branch 6 Choice
definition: Specifies the data used to identify the branch of a reporting counterparty.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the branch office of a reporting counterparty.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Code of a country where the registered office of the branch counterparty is located or country of residence in case that the branch counterparty is a natural person.
